title: SolarFilNet-V4: Multi-Scale Transformer Vision with Physics-Informed Adaptive Post-Processing for Solar Filament Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32193v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solar filaments are cool, dense chromospheric plasma structures held by magnetic field lines above polarity inversion lines. Their destabilization triggers coronal mass ejections and severe space weather hazards. Segmenting individual filaments from ground-based GONG H-alpha observations (2048 x 2048 pixels) is challenging due to low contrast, turbulent fibrils, delicate barb structures, and annotator boundary variance. In this technical report, we describe SolarFilNet-V4, a targeted segmentation framework developed for the MAGFiLO 1.0 benchmark (Solar Filament Segmentation Challenge 2026). Our method couples a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2-B1) backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions (k=15) and dual-frequency feed-forward blocks (DFFN) to follow extended flux ropes while capturing thin central spines. A shallow full-resolution convolutional branch operating at 1024 x 1024 preserves high-frequency edge

translated_title: SolarFilNet-V4：基于物理信息的自适应后处理与多尺度Transformer视觉的太阳暗条分割方法
translated_abstract: 太阳暗条是位于极性反转线上方、由磁力线支撑的低温高密度色球等离子体结构。它们的失稳会引发日冕物质抛射和严重的空间天气灾害。由于低对比度、湍流状的纤维结构、精细的暗条足结构以及标注者之间的边界差异，从地基GONG H-alpha观测数据（2048 x 2048像素）中分割单个暗条极具挑战性。在本技术报告中，我们介绍了SolarFilNet-V4，这是一个为MAGFiLO 1.0基准测试（2026年太阳暗条分割挑战赛）开发的针对性分割框架。我们的方法将轻量级金字塔视觉Transformer（PVT-v2-B1）骨干网络与各向异性曲线条带卷积（k=15）和双频前馈模块（DFFN）相结合，以追踪延伸的磁绳结构，同时捕捉纤细的中央脊线。一个在1024 x 1024分辨率下运行的浅层全分辨率卷积分支保留了高频边缘信息……
tldr: 该论文提出SolarFilNet-V4框架，将轻量级金字塔视觉Transformer与各向异性曲线条带卷积、双频前馈模块及物理信息自适应后处理相结合，以应对低对比度和复杂纤维结构等挑战，实现GONG H-alpha观测图像中太阳暗条的精准分割。
en_tdlr: SolarFilNet-V4 combines a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions, dual-frequency feed-forward blocks, and physics-informed adaptive post-processing to achieve accurate solar filament segmentation from low-contrast GONG H-alpha observations.
